Network Traffic Analysis Software & Tools

What it is, what to compare and how to choose

Network traffic analysis software shows what is happening on your network: which hosts and applications use the bandwidth, where latency and retransmissions come from, and which communications look suspicious.

This guide explains the data sources and the features to compare, and how ntopng covers them.

Data sources

Choose your data source

SourceBest forTrade-off
Packets (mirror port or TAP)Detail: applications, latency, TLS metadataNeeds capture at the monitoring point
Flows (NetFlow, sFlow, IPFIX)Many sites and routers with low overheadLess detail than packets, sampling may apply
SNMPDevice and interface health and utilizationNo view of applications or hosts

Checklist

Features to compare

  • Real-time and historical views of hosts, flows, interfaces and applications.
  • Layer-7 detection that works on encrypted traffic (nDPI recognizes hundreds of protocols).
  • Performance indicators such as round-trip time, retransmissions and throughput.
  • Alerts for anomalies, scans, blacklisted hosts and policy violations.
  • Integrations with Grafana, InfluxDB, firewalls and SIEMs.
  • Scale from a single link to thousands of hosts and multiple sites.

How ntopng and the ntop tools fit

ntopng

One interface for packets, flows, SNMP and firewall logs. Community edition is free.

nProbe

Brings flow data from routers and switches.

n2disk

Records packets so alerts can be investigated down to the packet.

nAnalyst

AI-assisted investigation on top of ntopng.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is network traffic analysis software?

Software that collects traffic data (packets, flows, SNMP) and turns it into answers: top talkers, application usage, performance problems and suspicious behavior.

Packets, flows or SNMP: which data source should I use?

Packets give the most detail, flows scale across many sites with little overhead, and SNMP gives device and interface health. Most networks combine them, and ntopng accepts all three.

Can ntopng analyze encrypted traffic?

ntopng cannot read encrypted payloads, but nDPI identifies the application and extracts metadata such as TLS handshake details and fingerprints, which is usually enough for visibility and anomaly detection.

Is there an AI option?

Yes. nAnalyst is an AI analyst layer for ntopng that lets you ask questions about your traffic in plain language and runs on your own infrastructure.
